title: Velouté Sauce
description: A classic French mother sauce prepared with a blond roux and white stock, creating a smooth, delicate sauce that serves as the foundation for many refined poultry, seafood, and veal sauces.

ingredients.title: For the Velouté Sauce
items: Hot white stock (chicken, veal, or fish) – 500 ml (2 cups)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Blond Roux
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk continuously for 3–4 minutes until a pale blond roux forms without allowing it to brown deeply.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Adding the Stock
steps: Gradually whisk in the hot white stock, adding a little at a time until the mixture is smooth and lump-free.
Continue whisking until all the stock has been incorporated.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Simmering the Sauce
steps: Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally until the sauce is lightly thickened and smooth.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finishing
steps: Strain the sauce through a fine sieve or chinois for a silky texture.
Season lightly with salt and white pepper before serving.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with roasted or poached chicken.
Pair with seafood such as fish or shellfish.
Use as the base for Suprême, Allemande, or Normande sauces.
Spoon over veal or other delicate white meats.

chefTips: Use a high-quality homemade white stock for the best flavor.
Avoid over-browning the roux to preserve the sauce's light color.
Whisk continuously while adding the stock to prevent lumps.
Strain the finished sauce for a smooth, restaurant-quality texture.
Velouté is one of the five classic French mother sauces and forms the base for many elegant derivative sauces.
